layout.tokens/: Token swatches (one per category, e.g. colors, radii, spacing, type, shadow, motion).
layout.components/: One SVG per ce-* component, showing all variants, sizes, states, and dark-theme variants.
layout.layout/: AppShell and responsive breakpoints (mobile / tablet / desktop).
layout.screens/: End-to-end user-journey mockups composed of design-system components.

tokens: doc: see docs/penpot/tokens.json for the machine-readable token table. Visual swatches can be generated from that file with a one-off script if needed.

layouts.description: Sidebar + Topbar + main grid for mobile (<640, drawer), tablet (640-1024, rail), desktop (>=1024, expanded).

notes: Every interactive component includes a visible a11y annotation (focus ring, ARIA role, keyboard pattern) inside the SVG frame.
Every screen and the AppShell layout include responsive annotations for mobile / tablet / desktop.
Every screen is composed exclusively of design-system components - no one-off shapes.

Color values inside the SVGs are inlined hex (resolved from the light-theme block of docs/penpot/tokens.json) so a designer can read the SVGs without a CSS engine. Dark-theme variants are shown in dedicated frames within the same SVG.
